summary: The Thai government is moving to cancel the 2001 MOU on overlapping maritime areas, citing 20 years of stagnant progress. Foreign Minister Sihasak clarified that the move does not mean stopping negotiations, but rather shifting the framework to the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) to ensure international standards and fairness. Both sides confirmed their commitment to maintaining the current ceasefire and using existing bilateral mechanisms to manage border tensions.
summaryKh: រដ្ឋាភិបាលថៃកំពុងឈានទៅរកការលុបចោល MOU ឆ្នាំ 2001 ស្តីពីតំបន់សមុទ្រត្រួតស៊ីគ្នា ដោយលើកឡើងពីការជាប់គាំងក្នុងរយៈពេល 20 ឆ្នាំកន្លងមកនេះ។ រដ្ឋមន្ត្រីការបរទេស លោក Sihasak បានបញ្ជាក់ថា ការផ្លាស់ប្តូរនេះមិនមែនមានន័យថាបញ្ឈប់ការចរចានោះទេ ប៉ុន្តែជាការប្តូរក្របខណ្ឌទៅជាអនុសញ្ញាអង្គការសហប្រជាជាតិស្តីពីច្បាប់សមុទ្រ (UNCLOS) ដើម្បីធានានូវស្តង់ដារអន្តរជាតិ និងយុត្តិធម៌។ ភាគីទាំងពីរបានបញ្ជាក់ពីការប្តេជ្ញាចិត្តក្នុងការរក្សាបទឈប់បាញ់បច្ចុប្បន្ន និងប្រើប្រាស់យន្តការទ្វេភាគីដែលមានស្រាប់ដើម្បីគ្រប់គ្រងភាពតានតឹងនៅតាមព្រំដែន។
summaryTh: รัฐบาลไทยกำลังเดินหน้ายกเลิก MOU 44 เกี่ยวกับพื้นที่ทับซ้อนทางทะเล โดยอ้างว่าใช้มา 20 ปีแต่ไม่มีความคืบหน้า นายสีหศักดิ์ชี้แจงว่าไม่ใช่การหยุดเจรจา แต่เป็นการเปลี่ยนไปใช้กรอบอนุสัญญาสหประชาชาติว่าด้วยกฎหมายทะเล (UNCLOS) เพื่อความชัดเจนและเป็นธรรมตามมาตรฐานสากล ทั้งนี้ทั้งสองฝ่ายยังยืนยันที่จะรักษาข้อตกลงหยุดยิงและใช้กลไกทวิภาคีที่มีอยู่ในการดูแลความสงบตามชายแดน
title: Sihasak officially informs Cambodian FM: Thailand preparing to cancel MOU 44, switching to UNCLOS

summary: Army Chief Gen. Pana Klaewplodthook has instructed units to maintain a high state of vigilance and gather intelligence following recent 'scattered' incidents that may have appeared provocative but lacked clear intent. The army spokesperson stated that while both sides are prepared, they remain within their respective sovereign territories. Regarding reports that China offered to mediate, the Thai military emphasizes that they rely on military intelligence over media rhetoric and note that while Cambodia has moved some bases back toward the border post-clash, they have not yet intruded into Thai-controlled areas.
summaryKh: អគ្គមេបញ្ជាការកងទ័ពជើងគោកថៃ លោកឧត្តមសេនីយ៍ Pana Klaewplodthook បានណែនាំដល់អង្គភាពនានាឱ្យរក្សាការប្រុងប្រយ័ត្នខ្ពស់ និងប្រមូលព័ត៌មានសម្ងាត់ បន្ទាប់ពីមានហេតុការណ៍ 'រាយប៉ាយ' នាពេលថ្មីៗនេះ ដែលអាចមើលទៅហាក់ដូចជាការឌឺដង ប៉ុន្តែមិនទាន់មានចេតនាច្បាស់លាស់។ អ្នកនាំពាក្យកងទ័ពបានថ្លែងថា ខណៈដែលភាគីទាំងសងខាងបានត្រៀមលក្ខណៈរួចជាស្រេច ពួកគេនៅតែស្ថិតក្នុងដែនអធិបតេយ្យភាពរៀងៗខ្លួន។ ចំពោះរបាយការណ៍ដែលថាប្រទេសចិនបានស្នើធ្វើជាអាជ្ញាកណ្តាល កងទ័ពថៃសង្កត់ធ្ងន់ថា ពួកគេផ្អែកលើព័ត៌មានសម្ងាត់យោធាជាជាងការនិយាយតាមប្រព័ន្ធផ្សព្វផ្សាយ ហើយបានកត់សម្គាល់ថា ទោះបីជាកម្ពុជាបានរំកិលមូលដ្ឋានមួយចំនួនមកជិតព្រំដែនវិញក្រោយការប៉ះទង្គិចក៏ដោយ ក៏ពួកគេមិនទាន់បានចូលឈ្លានពានក្នុងតំបន់ដែលថៃគ្រប់គ្រងនៅឡើយទេ។
summaryTh: พล.อ.พนา แคล้วปลอดทุกข์ ผบ.ทบ. กำชับหน่วยงานในพื้นที่ให้เฝ้าระวังและเก็บข้อมูลการข่าวอย่างต่อเนื่องหลังพบเหตุการณ์ยั่วยุประปรายแต่ยังไม่ชัดเจนในเจตนา โฆษกกองทัพบกเผยว่าทั้งสองฝ่ายมีการเตรียมพร้อมกำลังแต่ยังอยู่ในเขตอธิปไตยของตนเอง สำหรับกรณีที่จีนอาสาเป็นตัวกลางไกล่เกลี่ย กองทัพไทยเน้นย้ำว่าต้องดูข้อมูลการข่าวกรองทางทหารเป็นหลักมากกว่าข่าวจากสื่อ และระบุว่าแม้กัมพูชาจะขยับฐานกลับเข้ามาใกล้ชายแดนหลังเหตุปะทะ แต่ยังไม่พบการรุกล้ำพื้นที่ที่ไทยควบคุมอยู่

summary: The Royal Thai Army is closely monitoring the border following comments from Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi suggesting Cambodia no longer wishes to engage in conflict. Army Chief Gen. Phana Klaewplodtuk has ordered troops to remain vigilant, improve defensive positions, and verify intelligence. The army also noted that compensation of 10 million baht for soldiers injured or killed in the first round of clashes has been paid, while the second round is still in process.
summaryTh: กองทัพบกติดตามสถานการณ์ชายแดนอย่างใกล้ชิดหลัง หวัง อี้ รมว.ต่างประเทศจีน ระบุว่ากัมพูชาไม่อยากรบแล้ว ผบ.ทบ. สั่งการให้หน่วยในพื้นที่เฝ้าระวัง ปรับปรุงที่มั่น และเก็บข้อมูลการข่าวเพื่อประเมินสถานการณ์จริง นอกจากนี้ยังมีการติดตามเรื่องเงินเยียวยาทหาร 10 ล้านบาท โดยรอบแรกจ่ายครบแล้ว ส่วนรอบสองกำลังดำเนินการตามขั้นตอน

summary: Thai Deputy PM and Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow met with Cambodian Foreign Minister Prak Sokhonn in Brunei on April 27. Thailand officially informed Cambodia of its process to cancel the 2001 MOU regarding overlapping continental shelf claims (MOU 44). Sihasak emphasized that Cambodia must stop making 'distorted' public statements if they wish to continue bilateral talks and urged for a better atmosphere to be created before formal border committee (JBC) meetings can resume.
summaryKh: ឧបនាយករដ្ឋមន្ត្រី និងជារដ្ឋមន្ត្រីការបរទេសថៃ លោក Sihasak Phuangketkeow បានជួបជាមួយរដ្ឋមន្ត្រីការបរទេសកម្ពុជា លោក ប្រាក់ សុខុន នៅប្រទេសប្រ៊ុយណេ កាលពីថ្ងៃទី 27 មេសា។ ភាគីថៃបានជូនដំណឹងជាផ្លូវការដល់កម្ពុជាអំពីដំណើរការលុបចោលអនុស្សរណៈនៃការយោគយល់គ្នាឆ្នាំ 2001 (MOU 44) ស្តីពីតំបន់ត្រួតស៊ីគ្នា។ លោក Sihasak បានសង្កត់ធ្ងន់ថា កម្ពុជាត្រូវតែបញ្ឈប់ការថ្លែងការណ៍បំភ្លៃជាសាធារណៈ ប្រសិនបើពួកគេចង់បន្តការពិភាក្សាទ្វេភាគី ហើយបានជំរុញឱ្យបង្កើតបរិយាកាសល្អប្រសើរ មុនពេលកិច្ចប្រជុំគណៈកម្មាធិការព្រំដែន (JBC) អាចចាប់ផ្តើមឡើងវិញ។
summaryTh: นายสีหศักดิ์ พวงเกตุแก้ว รองนายกฯ และ รมว.ต่างประเทศ หารือกับนายปรัก สุคน รมว.ต่างประเทศกัมพูชา ที่บรูไนเมื่อวันที่ 27 เม.ย. โดยไทยแจ้งกัมพูชาอย่างเป็นทางการเรื่องกระบวนการยกเลิก MOU 44 (พื้นที่ทับซ้อนทางทะเลปี 2544) นายสีหศักดิ์ย้ำว่ากัมพูชาต้องหยุดแถลงบิดเบือนในเวทีต่างๆ หากยังต้องการคุยกับไทย และต้องสร้างบรรยากาศที่ดีก่อนจะมีการประชุมคณะกรรมการเขตแดน (JBC) ต่อไป

summary: Officials from Cambodia and Thailand met on Monday to discuss border tensions and the potential revocation of MoU 44 regarding maritime claims. While Cambodia expressed concern over unilateral actions and military barriers (shipping containers) placed by Thai forces in Pursat, Thailand maintains these measures are for security. The meeting aimed to manage the ceasefire following last year's armed clashes.

summary: A military demining unit (TMAC-1) discovered 32 active anti-personnel landmines in Sa Kaeo province on April 25. The find included 22 PMN and 10 MN79 mines. Since November 2025, over 189 explosive items have been cleared from the area, which was previously a conflict zone. Authorities warn residents to stay away from uncleared zones as the mission continues.

summary: Thailand has officially informed Cambodia of its intent to terminate the 2001 Memorandum of Understanding (MoU 44) regarding overlapping maritime claims. Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow delivered the news during a meeting in Brunei, stating that the 20-year-old agreement has seen little progress. Thailand seeks a new framework to better protect its interests, though it insists the move does not mean an end to bilateral talks.

summaryTh: ประเทศไทยได้แจ้งกัมพูชาอย่างเป็นทางการเรื่องความต้องการยกเลิก MOU 2544 เกี่ยวกับพื้นที่อ้างสิทธิทางทะเลทับซ้อน โดยนายสีหศักดิ์ พวงเกตุแก้ว รมว.ต่างประเทศ ได้แจ้งเรื่องนี้ระหว่างการประชุมที่บรูไน ระบุว่าข้อตกลงนี้ใช้มานานกว่า 20 ปีแต่ไม่มีความคืบหน้า ไทยจึงต้องการหาแนวทางใหม่เพื่อรักษาผลประโยชน์ชาติ แต่ยืนยันว่าไม่ได้เป็นการยุติการเจรจาระหว่างสองประเทศ

summary: The Royal Thai Army reported a tense encounter at the Chong Chom border in Surin Province. While Cambodian officials were escorting a diplomatic delegation to inspect the area, Thai authorities claim Cambodian soldiers repeatedly approached the Thai barbed wire line, violating joint agreements. In response, Thai troops fired three warning firecrackers to signal them to withdraw. Major General Winthai Suwaree stated that Thailand is issuing a formal protest letter, accusing Cambodia of trying to create a false image of Thai aggression.

summary: The Thai Ministry of Defence clarified that Thai forces did not use actual weapons during a recent encounter at the Chong Chom border area. Officials stated that soldiers only lit 3 firecrackers to warn Cambodian troops who were moving too close to the Thai barbed-wire fence. This response follows Cambodian allegations that Thai forces opened fire during a visit by foreign military attachés.

summary: The Second Army Region of Thailand clarified an incident near the Chong Chom (O'Smach) border crossing on April 29, 2026. After Cambodia alleged that Thai soldiers fired shots near a 'scammer building' close to the border, Thailand officially denied using weapons. The Thai military stated that the loud noises heard were from firecrackers, not bullets, during a period when Cambodian officials were escorting military attachés near the safety boundary line defined by Thai barbed wire.

summary: The Thai Army has issued a warning that it will strictly follow military guidelines if Cambodian troops violate border agreements or the December 2025 ceasefire. Tensions remain high due to reported troop movements near the fence and a dispute over dredging at Khlong Nam Sai in Sa Kaeo. Major General Benjapol of the Burapha Task Force insisted the area is Thai territory and that Thai forces will continue to patrol to protect sovereignty.

summary: Thai authorities including the Burapha Force and immigration police prepared to receive 635 Thai nationals at the Ban Khlong Luek border checkpoint in Aranyaprathet. However, Cambodian officials at Poipet have repeatedly delayed opening the border gate without explanation. The group consists of 190 illegal border crossers, 6 people involved in online crime cases, and 2 with arrest warrants. Thai officials are currently attempting to negotiate for their safe return.

summary: Cambodian authorities have begun the repatriation of the first batch of 350 Thai nationals through the Aranyaprathet border checkpoint. Thai officials are conducting screenings and legal checks, noting that a total of 635 individuals are expected to return under the bilateral cooperation framework.
